item.description: A disciplinary tribunal erred in its decision to clear barrister and former Hong Kong opposition lawmaker Margaret Ng Ngoi-yee of professional misconduct over her conviction for taking part in an unlawful assembly in 2019, a court was told on Monday. item.title: French PM brings forward minimum wage hike to calm protesters
item.description: French Prime ⁠Minister Sebastien Lecornu said on Monday he was bringing forward a planned hike in the minimum wage to December from January, as he sought to defuse a cost-of-living crisis that has sparked some of France’s worst civil unrest in years. item.description: Hong Kong’s Airport Authority has signed an agreement with the Yacht Club de Monaco to explore an affiliation for its future marina along with other related services as part of its HK$100 billion (US$12.8 billion) Skytopia megadevelopment. item.title: 10 dead, several injured in explosion at Turkey steel factory
item.description: An explosion ripped through an iron and steel factory in western Turkey on Monday, killing 16 people and injuring 13, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said, announcing investigations into the tragedy. Eight workers were trapped at the Habas steel factory about 60km (37 miles) north of the port city of Izmir where the blast struck at around midday, said Izmir governor Suleyman Elban.
